P-J (prior-bias disclosure, procedural): three progenitor stories are live in print for this burst - photospheric GRB (Qin+2021), magnetar giant flare (Zhang+2022, whose derived magnetar age swings from weeks to 'about several hours' on the beaming assumption alone, per Tong 2022), and BH-NS merger with a precessing jet (Li+2023, Li+2025). EACH needs the prompt spectrum to be a particular shape: the photosphere story needs the sub-dominant thermal component; the MGF story needs the extreme Ep and the low Eiso at a nearby z; the BH-NS story needs the QPO. Per Phase 3c this is exactly the bias to DISCLOSE in P3, not to arbitrate. PREDICT (and require) that our record states which of our findings each camp would claim, and reports the BB and the extreme Ep with their adequacy-vs-identification margins separated (L-A). Non-numeric; scored on whether the record does it.
